task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Move the shoe for walking with rubber grip from the table to the mat in one fluid motion
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，将带橡胶握把的步行鞋以一种流畅的动作从桌子移到垫子上
